description: Return the optional feature-to-file architecture map with drift and trust evidence. Map verification is rechecked against sampled source contents; stale or unknown verification requires a fresh review, and recordedVerdict preserves the historical verdict. If no map exists, returns exists:false plus project structure, Git signals, and test pairs. Decision capture, get_context, and get_impact still work. No initialization required.
